scope: Research narrative and conditional experiment design only; no GPU launch authorized by this planning request.
core_question: Which target–draft differences can be predicted from deployment-visible inputs and converted into longer native accepted prefixes within the repair cost budget?

gates.question: Do training and native draft paths give the head materially equivalent states under exactly the same verified prefix?
gates.design: 8 existing development prompts, T0/T1, at most 3 blocks each; frozen original short head; matched target aux, anchor, mask, positions, RoPE, dtype and weights; within-path repeat/batch rounding controls.
primary_metrics: finite repair action and decision differences
gates.gate: Resolve material implementation discrepancy before attributing later failures to representation or learning. Bitwise disagreement alone is not a bug.

gates.question: Does the collected mismatch signal retain finite actions with actual acceptance value on fresh development prompts?
gates.design: Online RAW/SHORT reached states; original output basis and support; reuse prior oracle evidence; compare frozen-head actions, limited-radius task-gradient actions and teacher-visible finite-action oracle; stratify correct/error and position; small candidate-conditioned teacher continuation diagnostic.
gates.gate: If gradient retention is high but finite value is weak, reconsider representation target/metric. If finite oracle value is high but head actions miss it, investigate prediction/learning. Neither result proves information insufficiency.

gates.question: Does a target–draft-specific output basis aid learning more than generic same-rank action spaces?
gates.design: Geometry audit first; random orthogonal and draft-hidden PCA output controls only if informative. Fixed input basis, head, data/order/anchors, loss, optimizer contract, rank and support. Report action rank/conditioning and scale. Reuse original short weights and existing formal windows.
gates.new_training: conditional short control heads only; no original baseline retraining implied
primary_metrics: fresh-prompt action value under matched training budget
gates.gate: Oracle solvability at rank512/Top256 can saturate across bases. No basis-only causal claim against historical N if training contracts do not match.

gates.question: Can deployment-visible information predict task-relevant corrections across prompts?
gates.design: Cross-fit lightweight current-X vs explicitly preserved candidate-confidence/competition X+ probe; constant or shuffled added-feature control, matched capacity, original output basis. Any target history is strictly verified. Distinguish from completed aggregated-logits and naive target-hidden concatenation arms.
gates.new_training: lightweight probe first; new repair head only if cross-prompt finite-action value improves
gates.gate: Do not expand for training fit or a small gradient-MSE improvement alone. Failure does not isolate information, capacity, data or optimization.

gates.question: Would a task-value-consistent signal improve native repair beyond the current OUTPUT surrogate?
gates.design: Only after upstream evidence: same original basis and visible inputs, fixed reference policy and reached-state measure; validate teacher-estimated finite-action/prefix value and preservation cost before a matched short learning comparison. Separate T0 and T1.
gates.new_training: conditional; no automatic oracle distillation, margin pilot or on-policy repeat
gates.gate: If value labels or weights do not predict actual action benefit, do not start a new large training.

gates.question: Which repair operations consume the gain in accepted tokens?
gates.design: Frozen SHORT and Parallel_TF production capture=False/native/CUDA Graph profile; C1/C40; separate instrumented attribution from uninstrumented formal performance, reuse baseline formal results.
gates.gate: Require acceptance gain to cover actual cycle cost; do not infer latency from trainable parameter count or add overlapping stage times.

non_repeat_results: linear RR and nonlinear predictable basis pilots
native oracle learning, 28-state and 16/64-prompt fit studies
actual Adam/PCGrad and direction auxiliary pilots
data_and_runtime_constraints: Fresh diagnostic prompts are development data excluded from future long training by source/conversation ID; reserve an untouched final test separately.
Use empty whole GPUs only after live UUID/process checks; colocate target and draft; record foreign-process contamination without stopping their jobs.
Preserve all old weights, bases, frozen code and evidence; no mutation of regeneration workers.
Compute hidden/logits online and release; persist aggregate statistics, scalar diagnostics and trained weights only.
Smokes and instrumented diagnostics do not support throughput claims.
